newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank sees appropriate crown level 110-119 TCW.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank sees appropriate crown level 110-119 TCW.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Thursday that the appropriate level for the crown against the Trade Currency Weighted (TCW) index in the longterm was still seen at a nominal 110-119.
The head of the bank's economic unit, Claes Berg, said it was more appropriate for the crown to be at the lower end of this range, between a nominal 110-115 in the TCW index or 110-114 in real terms.
"The longterm interval remains totally (valid)," Berg told a news conference after the Riksbank released its latest quarterly inflation report.
According to studies that the Riksbank carried out a year ago the appropriate level is at the lower end of this range.
The longterm range is the level that is compatible with the external and internal balance in the economy, Berg said.
Berg stressed that the Riksbank has no goal for the crown but sees these levels as appropriate.
